Phosphor Icons 2.0.3 (npm @phosphor-icons/web@2.0.3), "regular" style only, vendored for Mason on 2026-11-18
(UIFIX2 item 3).

Why: templates/mason_v2.html and ui/harness.html loaded the icon stylesheet from unpkg. It now ships with Mason,
so the icons show with no internet and the public repository has no CDN dependency.

Source (byte-for-byte what the page loaded before):
  https://unpkg.com/@phosphor-icons/web@2.0.3/src/regular/style.css
  https://unpkg.com/@phosphor-icons/web@2.0.3/src/regular/Phosphor.woff2      (asked for by style.css)
How verified: both files are byte-identical to src/regular/style.css and src/regular/Phosphor.woff2 in the npm
package @phosphor-icons/web@2.0.3 (package integrity
sha512-9oYmohi2fo87w3DbtfjBoJxrklVojgXq2wuGcqxKccj2TxMq7UIusKDrGUZYOQHM9pUKkh+kvfmutETMGDR6gg==, checked against
`npm view @phosphor-icons/web@2.0.3 dist.integrity`).

What is NOT here, on purpose:
  - the other icon styles (thin, light, bold, fill, duotone): the page uses only the regular "ph ph-…" icons;
  - Phosphor.woff, Phosphor.ttf, Phosphor.svg (351 KB, 351 KB, 1.2 MB): style.css is kept unchanged, so it still
    names them as fallbacks after the woff2 file. A browser takes the first format it supports, and every
    browser since 2016 supports woff2, so they are never asked for (checked in headless Chromium: 0 requests).

Do not edit these files. To upgrade, add a new versioned folder and change the link tag at the top of
templates/mason_v2.html and of ui/harness.html.
